title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: Those persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the Group, directly or indirectly, including any director (whether executive or otherwise) of the Group or its controlled entities.

tiers.name: Other Employees
tiers.description: An employee of the Group, other than Key Management Personnel, who has access to, or is in possession of, Unpublished, Price-Sensitive Information (e.g. staff working near KMP, finance/strategic planning staff, the layer of management below KMP, IT staff with email/document access).

tiers.name: Closely Related Parties of Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: Closely related parties (within the meaning of the Corporations Act) of Key Management Personnel; expressly bound by the hedging prohibition on unvested or holding-locked remuneration.

windows.start_anchor: 24 hours after release of the MND half yearly results to the Australian Securities Exchange
windows.end_anchor: 30 working days after release of the MND half yearly results

windows.start_anchor: 24 hours after release of the MND annual results to the Australian Securities Exchange
windows.end_anchor: 30 working days after release of the MND annual results

windows.start_anchor: 24 hours after the close of the MND Annual General Meeting
windows.end_anchor: 30 working days after the close of the MND Annual General Meeting

windows.start_anchor: any other time as the Board of Directors of MND permits

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board of Directors may declare that Key Management Personnel and Other Employees are prohibited from Dealing in MND Securities during the above trading periods even though those trading periods are not closed periods. Confidentiality of such a declaration is not addressed, though a refused or withdrawn Chairman's approval to deal must be kept confidential by the applicant.

rules.detail: Securities are expressly defined to include securities issued by third parties over MND Securities such as derivatives, so an OTC put/call is a Dealing. It is only permitted within an open trading period, and requires a pre-trade declaration to the Company Secretary that the person holds no Unpublished, Price-Sensitive Information; no discretionary approval is needed within a window.
rules.evidence: shares or other securities issued by MND or by third parties over MND’s securities (such as derivatives) (collectively, "Securities")

rules.detail: Corporations Act-based ban on hedging remuneration that has not vested, including securities issued under incentive plans, applying to Key Management Personnel and their closely related parties.
rules.evidence: Key Management Personnel and their closely related parties are prohibited from entering into hedging arrangements with respect of any part of their remuneration that has not vested, or that has vested but is subject to a holding lock.

rules.detail: Same Corporations Act-based ban extends to vested remuneration still subject to a holding lock.
rules.evidence: that has vested but is subject to a holding lock

rules.detail: The hedging prohibition is expressed to apply only to Key Management Personnel and their closely related parties; it is not stated to extend to Other Employees.

Once vested and free of a holding lock, hedging is not itself prohibited; it is caught only as an ordinary Dealing in Securities (which include third-party derivatives), so it requires an open trading period and a pre-trade no-inside-information declaration.
rules.evidence: Includes subscribing for, purchasing or selling, or entering an agreement to subscribe for, purchase or sell, Securities

rules.detail: Monetisation (e.g. a prepaid forward) is not named; it would be an agreement to sell Securities and so a Dealing, confined to open trading periods and subject to the pre-trade declaration.
rules.evidence: Includes subscribing for, purchasing or selling, or entering an agreement to subscribe for, purchase or sell, Securities

rules.detail: Short selling is not named or separately banned. Selling (even short) falls within the definition of Dealing, so it is confined to open trading periods and subject to the pre-trade declaration.
rules.evidence: Includes subscribing for, purchasing or selling, or entering an agreement to subscribe for, purchase or sell, Securities

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named anywhere, and lending is not a subscription, purchase or sale so is not caught by the Dealing definition.
CFDs are not named but fall within Securities (third-party derivatives over MND Securities) and so are a Dealing, confined to open trading periods and subject to the pre-trade declaration.
rules.evidence: shares or other securities issued by MND or by third parties over MND’s securities (such as derivatives) (collectively, "Securities")

rules.detail: Margin lending is not prohibited; it is expressly permitted subject only to notifying the Company Secretary, who then decides whether the arrangement requires market disclosure.
rules.evidence: Key Management Personnel or Other Employees must notify the Company Secretary if they enter into a margin lending facility or other secured financing arrangement affecting their MND Securities

rules.detail: Granting a charge, lien or other security over MND Securities is expressly addressed as part of the 'other secured financing arrangement' notification duty, not prohibited.
rules.evidence: notify the Company Secretary if they enter into a margin lending facility or other secured financing arrangement affecting their MND Securities

rules.detail: Any secured financing arrangement affecting MND Securities, not limited to margin loans, is expressly permitted, subject only to notifying the Company Secretary; the Company then decides whether market disclosure is required. No approval or window restriction is imposed on entering the financing itself.
rules.evidence: or other secured financing arrangement affecting their MND Securities. The Company will determine whether the arrangement requires disclosure to the market.

rules.detail: No short-term trading, minimum holding period or 'no sale within X months' rule appears anywhere in the Policy.

clearance.section: Restrictions on Dealing; Notification following Dealing
clearance.evidence: Key Management Personnel and Other Employees must notify the Company Secretary by completing MGL-F-553 Share Trading Policy Declaration before ... the Key Management Personnel or Other Employee, either Directly or Indirectly, Deals in MND Securities

clearance.approver: Chairman (or the Board of Directors if the Chairman is seeking approval or is unavailable)
clearance.section: Chairman's approval for Dealing during prohibited periods
clearance.evidence: In exceptional circumstances, the Chairman may permit Dealing in MND Securities by Key Management Personnel or Other Employees when this Policy would otherwise prohibit such Dealing.

exceptions.evidence: transfers of MND Securities already held into a superannuation fund or other saving scheme in which the relevant Key Management Personnel or Other Employee is a beneficiary

an investment in, or Dealing in units of, a fund or other scheme or arrangement (other than a scheme only investing in MND Securities) where the assets of the fund or other scheme are invested at the discretion of a third party

where the relevant Key Management Personnel or Other Employee is a trustee, Dealing in the Securities of MND by that trust provided the Key Management Personnel or Other Employee is not a beneficiary of the trust and any decision to Deal during a prohibited period is taken by the other trustees or by the investment managers independently
undertakings to accept, or the acceptance of, a takeover offer or similar transaction

Dealing under an offer or invitation made to all or most of the security holders, such as a rights issue, a security purchase plan, a dividend reinvestment plan or an equal access buy-back, where the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the MND Board of Directors.
where the beneficial interest in the relevant Securities does not change
a disposal of Securities of MND that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights, for example (where permitted), under a margin lending arrangement

the conversion of a convertible security held under an employee incentive scheme, where the final date for conversion of the security falls during a closed period and MND has been in an exceptionally long closed period or MND has had a number of consecutive closed periods and the Key Management Personnel or Other Employee could not have been expected to convert their security at a time when free to do so
the exercise (but not the sale of Securities following exercise) of an option or a right under an employee incentive scheme
withdrawal of MND Securities from an Employee Share Trust (but not the sale of Securities following withdrawal)

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or the Board of Directors if the Chairman is unavailable)
exceptions.evidence: the requirement to sell MND Securities due to the employee’s severe financial hardship

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or the Board of Directors if the Chairman is unavailable)
exceptions.evidence: a court order, court-enforceable undertaking or other overriding legal or regulatory requirement

financing_disclosure: Key Management Personnel and Other Employees; trigger: entering into a margin lending facility or other secured financing arrangement affecting their MND Securities; to the Company Secretary; deadline not specified, and the Company then determines whether market disclosure is required.

exemption_authority: The Chairman may permit Dealing during an otherwise prohibited period in exceptional circumstances (severe financial hardship, court order or other overriding legal/regulatory requirement, or otherwise at the Chairman's discretion), refusing or granting without giving reasons and able to withdraw approval on new information; if the Chairman is seeking approval or is unavailable, the Board of Directors must give prior approval instead.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Key Management Personnel or Other Employees must notify the Company Secretary if they enter into a margin lending facility or other secured financing arrangement affecting their MND Securities ... The Company will determine whether the arrangement requires disclosure to the market.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike many peer policies, MND does not prohibit margin lending or other secured financing over its securities; a bank loan secured on the collared shares only triggers a notification duty, with the Company deciding whether market disclosure is needed.

bespoke_clauses.clause: a disposal of Securities of MND that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights, for example (where permitted), under a margin lending arrangement
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An enforcement sale by the bank as secured lender falls outside the Policy entirely, so it is not blocked by a closed period or the need for Chairman approval.

bespoke_clauses.clause: shares or other securities issued by MND or by third parties over MND’s securities (such as derivatives) (collectively, "Securities")
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: OTC put/call derivatives referencing MND shares are expressly 'Securities', so the collar legs are subject to the same trading-window and notification regime as ordinary share dealings, rather than falling outside the Policy altogether.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The notification must state that the proposed Dealing is not as a result of access to, or being in possession of Unpublished, Price-Sensitive Information.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Within an open trading window there is no discretionary approval gate to negotiate -- only a pre-trade no-inside-information declaration -- so collar execution timing is largely within the executive's control once a window is open.

bespoke_clauses.topic: hedging ban limited to Corporations Act scope
bespoke_clauses.clause: Key Management Personnel and their closely related parties are prohibited from entering into hedging arrangements with respect of any part of their remuneration that has not vested, or that has vested but is subject to a holding lock.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Once incentive securities vest and any holding lock lifts, hedging is no longer expressly banned, opening the door to a funded collar over vested, unrestricted shares.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The Chairman reserves the right to approve or refuse a request without providing reasons and can withdraw approval if new information comes to light or there is a change of circumstances. Any decision of the Chairman is final.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Collar entry during a closed period cannot be relied upon until executed; the Chairman can withdraw a granted approval before the 5-working-day completion deadline expires.

summary: A funded collar over vested, unrestricted MND shares is workable for both Key Management Personnel and Other Employees. The Corporations Act-based hedging ban applies only to remuneration that is unvested or still subject to a holding lock; once vested and unrestricted, entering the put/call is treated as an ordinary Dealing (Securities expressly include third-party derivatives over MND shares) requiring only a pre-trade self-declaration to the Company Secretary of no inside information, executed within an open trading period (24 hours to 30 working days after results or the AGM, or as the Board otherwise permits). Critically, MND does not prohibit margin lending or other secured financing over its securities at all -- entering such an arrangement, including a pledge securing the funding leg of a collar, only triggers a notification to the Company Secretary, who decides whether market disclosure is required. A forced sale by the bank as secured lender exercising its rights is expressly excluded from the Policy altogether, so it is not blocked by a closed period. The main constraints are that collar entry, unwind or roll must fall within an open trading period or receive the Chairman's discretionary, confidential and revocable approval for exceptional circumstances, and post-trade details must be notified to the Company Secretary within 2 working days.
